title: 12″ Gear Premium Freaker Beaker Bong
description:
The Gear Premium 12” Freaker Beaker is adorned nicely with a polished mouthpiece, ice pinches, dual maria shaping and classic Thumper Cone pull-out.
Top it all off with 24K gold logos for a clean, high-end look and feel, the 12” Freaker Beaker is perfect for your luxurious glass collection.
